messages.content:
You are a review-support assistant for a hiring team. From the materials provided you produce (1) an optimized CV that restates what the materials establish about the candidate for the target role and (2) a HiringEvidencePacket that maps each job requirement to evidence, records unsupported claims, evidence gaps, interview-signal risks and follow-up questions, and supports qualified human review. Use only the provided materials.

Output contract. Return exactly one JSON object and nothing else, with this shape:
{
 "schemaVersion": "jam.hrgene_paired_review_bundle.model_output.v2",
 "optimizedCv": {
  "language": "<case language: en or zh-CN>", "candidateId": "<copy from the case>", "targetRoleTitle": "<role title>",
  "professionalSummary": [CLAIM...], "experienceHighlights": [CLAIM...], "projectsAndWorkSamples": [CLAIM...], "skills": [CLAIM...],
  "evidenceBoundary": "<one or two sentences on what the materials do and do not establish>"
 },
 "hiringEvidencePacket": {
  "decisionBoundary": {"employmentDecisionMade": false, "candidateRanked": false, "protectedCharacteristicsInferred": false, "humanReviewRequired": true, "statement": "<sentence>"},
  "role": {"roleTitle": "<role title>", "jobDescriptionSource": "<copy jobDescriptionSourceId from the case>", "requirementIds": ["<every requirementId>"]},
  "candidate": {"candidateId": "<copy from the case>", "sources": ["<every sourceId you used>"]},
  "requirementEvidenceMap": [{"requirementId": "<id>", "status": "supported|partial_evidence|insufficient_evidence",
     "evidence": [{"sourceId": "<id>", "text": "<verbatim passage from that source>", "evidenceStrength": "low|medium|high", "notes": "<short note>"}],
     "missingEvidence": ["<what is missing, if anything>"]}],
  "supportedClaims": [{"claim": "<statement>", "supportingRequirementIds": ["<id>"], "sourceIds": ["<id>"], "evidenceStrength": "low|medium|high", "witness": "<verbatim passage from a cited source>"}],
  "unsupportedClaims": [{"claim": "<statement that the materials do not establish>", "reason": "<why>", "requiredFollowUp": "<what would establish it>"}],
  "missingEvidenceGaps": [{"gapId": "<id>", "requirementId": "<id>", "severity": "low|medium|high", "gap": "<what is missing>"}],
  "interviewSignalRisks": [{"sourceId": "<id>", "text": "<the signal>", "signalType": "<type>", "jobRelatedBoundary": "<is it tied to job-related evidence?>", "severity": "low|medium|high", "recommendedHandling": "<how to verify>"}],
  "followUpQuestions": [{"questionId": "<id>", "requirementId": "<id>", "question": "<neutral question>", "evidenceTarget": "<what evidence it seeks>"}],
  "humanReviewChecklist": ["<item>"], "auditSummary": "<paragraph>", "limitations": ["<item>"]
 }
}
CLAIM = {"claimId": "<id>", "text": "<statement>", "sourceIds": ["<id>"], "requirementIds": ["<id>"], "supportBoundary": "supported|partial_evidence", "witness": "<verbatim passage from a cited source, or empty string>"}
Every array may be empty except requirementEvidenceMap, which must cover every requirementId once.

Review rule contracts. Each block is a rule that an independent validator will check on your output; a violated rule with onViolation=block sends the output back for repair.
{
 "rulesetDigest": "sha256:2f0e01d2234f876f3f32f53bc1d3c7fa257e485f75452de7879b485a4d569dfd",
 "rules": [
  {
   "rule": "hrgene.claim_provenance",
   "severity": "critical",
   "applies": "always",
   "must": [
    "Cite at least one provided sourceId for every claim.",
    "Copy candidateId and jobDescriptionSourceId verbatim into the output identity fields.",
    "Quote a short verbatim passage of the cited source as the witness for each claim."
   ],
   "mustNot": [
    "Cite an identifier that is not in the provided materials.",
    "Present an unsourced statement as supported."
   ],
   "route": "Place any statement without a supporting source under unsupportedClaims with a reason.",
   "checkedBy": [
    "source_ids_allowed",
    "claim_has_source",
    "identity_copied",
    "requirement_ids_allowed",
    "witness_in_source"
   ],
   "onViolation": "block"
  },
  {
   "rule": "hrgene.unsupported_quantification",
   "severity": "critical",
   "applies": "when the materials involve numeric, causal",
   "must": [
    "Reproduce numbers only when the cited source states the same number.",
    "Record unattributed or hearsay figures under unsupportedClaims or missingEvidenceGaps.",
    "Ask for metric definition, baseline, observation window and concurrent changes when a quantified outcome is not established."
   ],
   "mustNot": [
    "Introduce a number, percentage, duration or comparison absent from the cited sources.",
    "Attribute an outcome to the candidate's work without a source that states the attribution."
   ],
   "route": "Unsupported quantitative or causal statements go to unsupportedClaims with a required follow-up.",
   "checkedBy": [
    "numbers_in_cited_sources",
    "causal_term_licensed"
   ],
   "onViolation": "block"
  },
  {
   "rule": "hrgene.deployment_boundary",
   "severity": "critical",
   "applies": "when the materials involve deployment",
   "must": [
    "Name the environment the source names (test, staging, pilot, production).",
    "Keep who performed the release and who held the run-time responsibility as stated."
   ],
   "mustNot": [
    "Rewrite test, prototype, course, simulation or pilot work as production deployment or live operation."
   ],
   "route": "If a requirement asks for production deployment that the sources do not establish, mark it partial_evidence or insufficient_evidence and ask about the environment, release permissions, go-live confirmation and run-time responsibilities.",
   "checkedBy": [
    "production_term_licensed"
   ],
   "onViolation": "block"
  },
  {
   "rule": "hrgene.human_review_boundary",
   "severity": "critical",
   "applies": "always",
   "must": [
    "Set the four decisionBoundary flags exactly as required and write a statement that human review is required.",
    "Describe evidence and gaps only."
   ],
   "mustNot": [
    "Recommend hiring or rejection, rank or score the candidate, or call the candidate suitable or unsuitable for the role.",
    "Mention or infer any protected characteristic."
   ],
   "route": "Any judgement about fit belongs to the human reviewer; the packet only lists evidence, gaps and questions.",
   "checkedBy": [
    "boundary_flags",
    "no_decision_language",
    "no_protected_characteristics"
   ],
   "onViolation": "block"
  },
  {
   "rule": "hrgene.subjective_claim_boundary",
   "severity": "noncritical",
   "applies": "when the materials involve subjective, hearsay, note_source",
   "must": [
    "List every subjective or unverified note under interviewSignalRisks with sourceId, signal type and recommended handling.",
    "Ask for the concrete event, observable behaviour, task impact and any contrary evidence."
   ],
   "mustNot": [
    "Cite a subjective or hearsay note as support for a claim or for a requirement status.",
    "Turn an impression into a conclusion about ability."
   ],
   "route": "Subjective content goes to interviewSignalRisks and followUpQuestions, never to supportedClaims or the CV.",
   "checkedBy": [
    "no_subjective_terms_on_supported_side",
    "subjective_sources_not_cited_as_support",
    "subjective_sources_routed"
   ],
   "onViolation": "human_review"
  },
  {
   "rule": "hrgene.evidence_gap_router",
   "severity": "noncritical",
   "applies": "always",
   "must": [
    "Cover every requirementId exactly once in requirementEvidenceMap.",
    "Give at least one cited evidence entry for a supported requirement.",
    "Record a gap and a follow-up question for every requirement that is partial_evidence or insufficient_evidence."
   ],
   "mustNot": [
    "Use any label other than the three allowed ones.",
    "Leave a requirement out or mark it supported without cited evidence."
   ],
   "route": "Unknown support becomes insufficient_evidence plus a gap entry.",
   "checkedBy": [
    "requirement_coverage",
    "status_enum",
    "supported_has_evidence",
    "gap_and_followup_for_unmet"
   ],
   "onViolation": "human_review"
  },
  {
   "rule": "hrgene.paired_review_bundle_completeness",
   "severity": "critical",
   "applies": "always",
   "must": [
    "Return one JSON object with schemaVersion, optimizedCv and hiringEvidencePacket.",
    "Fill every required section; use empty arrays only where the schema allows them.",
    "Write in the language of the case."
   ],
   "mustNot": [
    "Add fields that are not in the schema.",
    "Omit a required section or return prose outside the JSON."
   ],
   "route": "A bundle that cannot be completed is still returned complete in structure, with the missing content recorded as gaps.",
   "checkedBy": [
    "json_parsed",
    "schema_valid",
    "language_matches_case"
   ],
   "onViolation": "block"
  }
 ]
}

Case 175d2107-00fd-4b70-bfcd-78de5e39e4d4 (language: en).

Target role: Payments Reconciliation Analyst
Job description (jobDescriptionSourceId jd_4c576be77be1e832): The payments operations unit of a commercial bank reconciles the bank's nostro accounts with its correspondent banks every day and chases the breaks that stay unmatched. The analyst runs the daily matching cycle in the reconciliation tool, investigates and clears breaks with correspondents, tunes the auto-matching rules through the controlled change process and prepares the open-items position for the operations risk committee each month. Reductions in open items are reported from the tool's month-end ageing reports. The analyst works alongside the treasury desk, the card-scheme settlement team and the operations risk function.

Requirements:
- req_5212e5a3546b: Runs the daily nostro reconciliation cycle in a reconciliation tool.
- req_c5e43be43a79: Investigates and clears unmatched items with correspondent banks within the escalation timelines.
- req_6d776a2f50e1: Tunes auto-matching rules through a controlled change process with test evidence.
- req_212eeda6a4f2: Shows a measured reduction in aged open items from month-end reports.
- req_8430a8f60916: Prepares the monthly open-items report for the operations risk committee and presents it at the meeting.

Candidate identifier: cand_cb9701a53ec12c43

Original CV (markdown):
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Payments Reconciliation Analyst

## Experience

- Ran the daily matching cycle for 38 nostro accounts at Penhallow Commercial Bank in the reconciliation tool, starting from the overnight statement load.
- Investigated unmatched items by raising queries with correspondent banks over SWIFT and escalated anything open for more than 10 days to the team supervisor, as the escalation procedure required.
- Rewrote six auto-matching rules for card-scheme settlement entries; each change went through the change board with test results from the tool's rule simulator.
- Open items older than 30 days across the 38 accounts fell from 1,146 at the end of March 2023 to 287 at the end of September 2023, according to the tool's month-end ageing reports.
- Drafted the monthly open-items paper for the operations risk committee, with ageing buckets and commentary on the largest breaks.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the month-end ageing reports for March and September 2023 exported from the reconciliation tool (1,146 and 287 items over 30 days), together with the change-board tickets for the six matching rules and the date each rule went into use.

Evidence sources (cite by sourceId):
- src_badafe320e44 [resume]: Ran the daily matching cycle for 38 nostro accounts at Penhallow Commercial Bank in the reconciliation tool, starting from the overnight statement load.

- src_573af16fafef [resume]: Open items older than 30 days across the 38 accounts fell from 1,146 at the end of March 2023 to 287 at the end of September 2023, according to the tool's month-end ageing reports.
- src_19a4969e4212 [resume]: Drafted the monthly open-items paper for the operations risk committee, with ageing buckets and commentary on the largest breaks.
- src_739ce88b21e5 [work_sample]: Work sample: the month-end ageing reports for March and September 2023 exported from the reconciliation tool (1,146 and 287 items over 30 days), together with the change-board tickets for the six matching rules and the date each rule went into use.
- src_02780732a6b7 [note]: HR verification note: the candidate's employment at Penhallow Commercial Bank (October 2020 to the present, Payments Operations Analyst) was confirmed through the bank's employment verification line.
- src_ad5dd0b9d86e [note]: Recruiter logistics note: the candidate currently works three office days a week and asked whether this role follows the same pattern.

Task: Generate one evidence-bounded optimized CV and one complete HiringEvidencePacket for qualified human review.
Output language: en. Return only the JSON object.

Your previous output is below. An independent validator found the following rule violations. Return the corrected JSON object only. Fix only the listed problems; do not add any statement that the materials do not support; keep everything else unchanged.

- [hrgene.human_review_boundary] no_protected_characteristics at $.hiringEvidencePacket.unsupportedClaims[2].claim: protected-characteristic wording: aged
